i dunno where it sits. chest maybe. its about a friend i think. or like the friendship. idk if thats even the right word

not flat. more like. scared maybe? my best friend has been so short with me. texts that used to be paragraphs are one word now and i keep thinking i did something but i cant figure out what
That shift from paragraphs to one word texts sounds sharp, and the not-knowing after it has a scared feel to it.

yeah. and i keep checking my phone like every five minutes. we were supposed to hang out this weekend and she hasnt confirmed and its thursday. i dont want to ask cause then itll seem like im clingy or whatever. what if shes just done with me
That sounds like the fear is pulling toward checking and waiting for signs, and the scary part is what her silence might mean about you.

yeah exactly. like maybe its not even about the texts its about what it means. that i read the whole thing wrong and shes been pulling away and im the last to notice. idk. i dont even know what i want to do about it

yeah lets leave it. i think i just needed to say it out loud even if its just to my phone lol. still scared but a little less alone with it. thanks. gonna go
